# The moon's glint on the water: flat dashes 4 cm above the river in a column, wider near the camera.
# Up Z; the column runs along world +z from 0 to 7.
new
material new Glint --base-color 0.8353 0.2353 0.4157 --emission 0.8353 0.2353 0.4157 --no-slot
material new Glint2 --base-color 0.4863 0.0941 0.2353 --emission 0.4863 0.0941 0.2353 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name G0 --size 1 --location 0.121 -0.300 0.030
scale 0.632 0.160 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glint2
add mesh cube --name G1 --size 1 --location 0.221 -1.200 0.030
scale 0.819 0.160 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glint
add mesh cube --name G2 --size 1 --location 0.211 -2.100 0.030
scale 0.937 0.160 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glint2
add mesh cube --name G3 --size 1 --location -0.017 -3.000 0.030
scale 0.859 0.160 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glint
add mesh cube --name G4 --size 1 --location 0.074 -3.900 0.030
scale 1.268 0.160 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glint2
add mesh cube --name G5 --size 1 --location -0.193 -4.800 0.030
scale 1.390 0.160 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glint
add mesh cube --name G6 --size 1 --location -0.127 -5.700 0.030
scale 1.396 0.160 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glint2
select all
shade flat
export glint.glb
